note: Campground 1 at St. Joe State Park near Park Hills, the campground beside the park's off-road-vehicle riding area and the one ORV riders must use; campers without ORVs or horses may use it too. Shaded asphalt pads among oaks; four lakes, two beaches and paved bike trails elsewhere in the park. Generators are not allowed. After-hours entry by the gate code on the reservation confirmation. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $14-15 basic base and electric +12 (2027 = 2026); added military $2, 50A with no water/sewer at the sites, 73 sites (42-126 ft), showers/flush/dump/water, 12-month window, walk-up after cutoff, 15-in-30, reservations year-round (weekend 2-night minimum already manual). Not waterfront kept; pin on Campground 1: kept. ORV question: a state park campground with an ORV side, open to all campers.
flags: ORV QUESTION (for a human, criteria): the park bills itself as an ORV park, but its campground is a general state-park campground with an ORV side. Main page: 'St. Joe State Park, one of two off-road vehicle parks in the state park system. The many trails set aside for off-road vehicle use make the park the premiere off-road vehicle area. The park also features four lakes, two swimming beaches, equestrian trails, hiking and bicycling trails, a water trail, and picnic sites, as well as two campgrounds capable of accommodating campers with ORV or horse trailers.' Camping page chart: 'If you will have ... Off-road vehicles (ORVs) - then you must camp in Campground 1 ... Neither an ORV nor a horse - Either campground'; Campground 1 is labelled '(ORV Area)'. Reading: Campground 1 is the ORV riders' required campground but is open to and booked by general campers, in a park whose lakes, beaches and trails are its other half - a general campground with an OHV side (stays under AWH 2026-10-02), not an OHV staging camp. Expect ORV noise and traffic; the stored note's 'Off-road-vehicle park' was rewritten to say this.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the nearest sites (Campground 1's 111-113 at the north end of the 101-125 row) are ~80-110 m from the nearest of the park's lakes through continuous woods on leaf-off Esri imagery; sites 1-50 are farther. The equestrian Campground 2 is not this entry.
PIN 37.8101,-90.5148 sits in Campground 1's sites 1-50 loop, 73 m from their centre: kept. Sites 101-125 centre 37.8130,-90.5161.
